title: Artifact for: Where the Dimension Hides: Certifying the Approximation Constant of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
description: Code, run logs and analysis outputs for the manuscript "Where the Dimension Hides: Certifying the Approximation Constant of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks". The repository contains the pre-registered pipeline, the closed-form certification probe, the checkpointed run log of 33,300 fitted cells (manifest digest 4e5b8b0777fa9959), every analysis table in machine-readable form, the vector figures and the machine-generated verdict. An analysis-only path regenerates every reported table, figure and the verdict on a CPU in minutes.
